title: The Fire Nobody Lit

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Every hearth said it had kept the flame and none said where it began. The collector wrote down what was already going. The bell said four, four and a gap, and the dark kept the rest.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, told during the Five

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and ninety to three hundred and ninety-two days, six months and two hundred and ten to two hundred and twelve days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. As in chapters 25 through 112 the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone until one remembered line earns a single present-tense break on the Long Night, untagged and never a `\memory{}`: a clean voice saying a name over a room that does not look up, and hands that stay in the field. No departure from the boy's eyes. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and not made again, still a finding and not a placing; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. The chapter lives the first three of the Five: Kindling, when the year's fire comes up the Clay Yard in a clay dish from hearth to hearth and enters the house from a source nobody names or prices, and a collector takes the year's first measure with an ordinary writing hand and no pause in it; Weighing, when the measures are read in a clean voice wearing the grammar of the Cross in a temple's clothes, a whole return announced for somebody absent and a name the household will not repeat; and the Long Night, no fire after dusk, with stories of the Return whose gaps have the shape of vessels' intervals and a bell told four, four and a gap kept in its square beside the bell he heard. The carried fire's payer stays unnamed and its fifth pull unpaid though the year is counted complete; twelve arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine out of twelve; the keeping at the fold stays a finding; no sixth hearing, tenth hand, eighth opening, witness, reader or payer stands. The Remembering, the Last Day and Ilmen 1 of Y.H. 814 stand beyond the close.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Dish Going Up the Yard
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{390}{Kindling, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the first of the Five under the Vail kiln-house roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, hand laid flat on answer 354 and count exact at 389 carried in from Chapter 112. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (the salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the twice-mended pot's hairline, the unforged collector sentence at the kindling, the uncalled tile debt). Walk-ons only: the unnamed households who pass the year's fire up the Clay Yard in a clay dish from hearth to hearth before first light. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell on this morning; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Stone 28, 29 or 30 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and Kindling is not called an opening, a payment or a boundary. Dramatic purpose: the year's fire enters the house from a source nobody names or prices, so the carried fire's payer stays unnamed and the fifth pull stays unpaid though the year is counted complete (T088 advancing toward the later naming of the Hearth as a wound). The surgeon takes the body in its old order — leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place holding the fold found where put and not made again, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict. Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says the house will keep it where another woman would say I, counts an intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread and her lips on a two-gapped row figured neither way, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. She carries him down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place. Each house along the yard says it kept the flame and nobody says where it was first lit or what it cost; the dish goes from hearth to hearth and the coal enters under the back of a broken pot with no hand under this roof making an opening of it. Under the floor the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood. The widow's mark is not touched: a holy day is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule with no eighth made due. The keeping is found where put and stays a finding; the twelve arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine. In the small hours the towel comes out as instruments come out when a case is done, every gap left a gap, and answer 355 is filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer.

scenes.title: The Measure Is Banked
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Kindling morning through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 356. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, the collector who takes the year's first measure (a walk-on, no sheet), a neighbour whose measure is taken (a walk-on, no interior entered); Garl Vail in objects. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice. Dramatic purpose: a record-first hand arrives with no pause in it and the boy files it on a tray of its own — not Marra, not the Court-table clerk, not the Fishstairs clerk, not the Drawing collector, expressly not a tenth hand — and plants, unspoken, the reason that will one day be remembered against the taker: that he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going (T080/T090 advanced, not paid). Sella carries the basket to the room two doors down and sets him at the edge of the light where he can see and not join, standing half a pace off and giving no instruction to the basket. The collector comes in out of the cold with a flat leather satchel, a cuff gone soft from washing and folded back twice with the grey of the wash worked into the seam at the wrist, a cold iron tube out of a roll of wool grey at the light and darker where his fingers have it, and fingertips grey at the tips the colour of skimmed milk gone off. His hand goes to the slate before his eyes go to the bed, and he says once, low, to the slate: The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded. The hand that writes is ordinary with no pause in it. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and files it on its own tray with a finger between it and the neat dark hand, Hessa Rale's eighth, Ilva's ninth, Berr Clay's twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate and the Drawing collector's ordinary hand; no tenth stands up in the empty place. The neighbour under the tube is not named and gives no interior: a small sound in the room, then the pale round place on the arm afterward, not a wound and no blood; the boy does not make a seventh hearing of any sound and does not fill the empty place with it. The reason for the taking is planted and not spoken — the man believes he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going, and that belief, not anger, is what will one day be remembered against him. At the going of the light Sella carries him home, sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and adds no second fold; she says nothing of the room, the tube, the slate or the woman. The keeping is found where put and stays a finding; the fire keeps four and a gap; the widow's mark is untouched because a collection and a going of the light are not openings. Small hours: the file comes out on the towel with every gap left gap and answer 356 filed.

scenes.title: The Clean Voice
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{391}{Weighing, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the second of the Five, then the morning's word coming up the Clay Yard from the reading, with answer 357. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours coming back up the yard who repeat the clean voice's grammar and the name no further. No Berr, Sill assessor, Drawing collector, collector of the morning, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards. New day, new date, no recap: the Kindling measure stays on its own tray and buys no reading under this roof. Dramatic purpose: a voice announces a whole return for somebody absent in the grammar of the Cross wearing a temple's clothes, takes the speaker neatly out of his own sentences, and leaves a silence after a name the household will not repeat; the boy files that silence among the gaps (T080/T090 and T081 advanced, not paid). Word of the Weighing arrives in the yard as a voice people have been holding in the ear and repeating without meaning to: a whole return read for a person not in any room here, and a name spoken cleanly and then not spoken again. The boy hears the voice at a distance and neither sees a room nor enters one: the four rooms that keep the same gap — birth room, Vail kiln-house, market-day slate room, Drawing house — stay four with a finger between every pair and are not made five by this reading; no Court room is brought under the roof as a new likeness. The officer is not Berr Clay, not the Sill assessor and not the Drawing collector; the speaker is taken out of his sentences the way another hand takes itself out of a sentence, filed on a place of its own and joined to none, and no tenth hand is made of him. The name is not repeated by the household and not written into the boy's file; he keeps the silence after it on the gap tray beside the told bell's gap and the unfigured spaces, with no payer standing and no cause written across it. Sella keeps the hearth grammar at both ends, goes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, keeps her finger above the charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reach with a half-beat, carries him at the half-pace from every open slate, goes wide around the seven places, and sets him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold righted and no second fold. The keeping is found where put; the carried fire keeps four low pulls and a missing fifth with its payer unnamed 391 days; the widow's mark is untouched because a holy day is not an opening and no eighth is made due. Small hours: answer 357 filed on the towel, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.

scenes.title: A Term That Does Not End
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Weighing through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 358. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a Cold Acre hare-carrier shifting a hare across his shoulders, a cracked-jar man in a rope sling, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders arguing the thaw. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice (four directions stand where put, do not repeat, buy no lesson). Dramatic purpose: Tarn stands at the very end of a seventh year with the loan uncalled and the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure — a term ending is not freedom, not a payment, not a forgiveness — while the boy refuses to let the silence after the clean voice's name stand up with Tarn's stopped sentence or Jorra's ungiven promise and call themselves a rule. Out in the Clay Yard the afternoon stands in the dry cold and the yard goes around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back; the three coverings and the river's skin stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and the field keeps its empty place. Costs arrive as directions and go away as weather: the hare to the weather that carried the snow and can carry the price, the cracked jar to a pot that says nothing, Yes, house to the kindling woman and to the fence-menders wanting the thaw early and late, keeping the late because it puts off the paying and agreeing so thoroughly that no argument finds a foot. At the kindling six pieces stand in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt; the small knife lies at the very edge of its sill, the hand passes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, and he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, cutting, counting and spending nothing. The Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again; he brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year now at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and no look along the road. Chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist giving back the little light, his stroke over the shallow bright patch of the flagstones without the half-check. Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel; three or more men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him and no word that the room was cold; dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel; wheel and pot spoken to before any person; the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early; bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, taking the cold out of the fingertip, moving the tongue a hair's breadth, and out without a second holding of Ash 26. He's not Vail stays sealed; the promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness and the well-saying at four shapings. At the going of the light the household grammar is renewed and the widow's mark is untouched. Small hours: the silence after the name, the stopped sentence and the ungiven promise are checked on three separate places with a finger between every pair; answer 358 filed.

scenes.title: No Fire After Dusk
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{392}{the Long Night, Y.H. 813}: the small hours opening the third of the Five, then the daylight and the going of the light, with answer 359. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours making ready for the dark and speaking the bell as four, four and a gap. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell rung; no ownerless voice over the boards. New day, new date, no recap: the measure taken on Kindling and the clean voice of Weighing stay behind the household and buy no teaching here. Dramatic purpose: the year's dark is kept by not-doings, and the told bell of the Long Night is set in its square beside the bell the boy heard, four, four and a gap, never folded into the counts and never made a seventh hearing. The surgeon takes the body in its old order, knows a face composed by cold is not composure and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside slowly, never hurried, never rubbed, and that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and the quarrel goes on without verdict. Sella banks the fire early against the going of the light and tells the coals it is the thaw where another woman would say I, turns them with the back of a broken pot, keeps her finger above the charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. She carries him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, goes around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, and sets him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold righted and no second fold; the keeping is found where put and stays a finding. No fire is lit after dusk: the carried fire under the floor gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 392 days, and nobody lifts the floor or supplies the pull. In the yard the bell is told four, four and a gap, and the boy keeps the told bell in its square beside the bell he heard from the Cross, the gap not folded into the fire's four and a gap, the boards' four and four and a knot, or the twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, and not made a seventh of anything. The stories of the Return are spoken of as coming around in the dark, with gaps in them the shape of vessels' intervals; no story is told yet under this roof and no voice comes over the boards. Small hours: answer 359 filed on the towel with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: The Gap in the Story
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the Long Night after dusk through the small hours, with answer 360 and the count at 392 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: unnamed neighbours sitting in the dark who tell the stories of the Return, one of whom tells a story in which a whole return is announced in a clean voice and the name is left out. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put and do not repeat and buy no lesson. Dramatic purpose: the stories of the Return go around with gaps the shape of vessels' intervals, and one remembered line earns the chapter's single present-tense break, untagged, one or two sentences, never for anticipation and never a `\memory{}` — a clean voice saying a name over a room that does not look up, the white room and the page over the speakers, hands staying in the field; then the grammar falls back into the past and nothing is paid. On this night there is no fire after dusk; the house sits in the dark with the carried fire four under the floor and its fifth unpaid, and the boy is held where the heat comes sideways and not given the crust, the thread or a hand on the pot handle. A neighbour tells a story of a whole return announced in a clean voice for somebody absent, and comes to the place where a name would stand and leaves it standing empty; the boy files that silence on the gap tray beside the told bell's gap, the silence after Weighing's name and the unfigured spaces, with no payer named and no cause written across them. He does not let the story's gap stand up as a hearing, a seventh of anything, a witness, a reader, a payment or a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The present-tense break comes only on that clean voice and a name spoken over a room that does not look up: the page and the white room and the hands that stay in the field for one or two sentences, then back to the dark under the Vail roof. The bell is told once more four, four and a gap and kept in its square beside the heard bell, never made a seventh hearing and not joined to the three counts in three places. The keeping at the fold is found where put and stays a finding; Tarn's loan is uncalled at the very end of a seventh year, Jorra's promise neither given nor withdrawn, the widow's mark untouched, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside, four rooms with the same gap held apart, and twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine out of twelve. The count reaches 392 exact, six months and two hundred and twelve days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number. Exact last image: the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door, not reaching, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ends and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking; answer 360 filed, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the kept things. The Remembering and the Last Day stand beyond the dark unbrought, and Ilmen 10 of Y.H. 814 waits for the new year's first arithmetic, which will be a reset and not a signing.
